claimBoundary: This matrix repeats the controlled 4:4:4/4:2:2/4:4:0/4:2:0 axis isolation across four retained public-domain real photographs. Each source is first decoded to a fixed RGB encoder input using the pinned libjpeg-turbo installation, then every sampling variant holds those RGB bytes, encoder quality, Huffman optimization and progressive mode constant.

Cross-backend deltas compare ImageCraft/ImageIO against one-shot pinned libjpeg-turbo. Source-fidelity deltas compare each decoder independently against the exact RGB bytes supplied to cjpeg, so they measure reconstruction fidelity for the controlled re-encode rather than fidelity to an unknown original scene.

No observed code delta, MAE or PSNR becomes a conformance tolerance. Consistency across the four sources can strengthen an axis-mechanism inference, but it does not prove perceptual superiority or generalize beyond the qualified encoder/settings/runtime domain.
